newsitem.title: USA: Thomson unit in banking Web site venture.
newsitem.headline: Thomson unit in banking Web site venture.

text.p: Thomson Financial Services said on Tuesday it formed a partnership to set up an interactive Web site that lets consumers shop on line for banking products and services.
Thomson, a Thomson Corp unit, supplies the data content, and its partner Findex.com Inc contributes its interactive Web-site technology, Thomson said.

The partnership, called TFP/Findex, plans to sell advertising and market memberships starting at $2,495 to financial institutions that want to be included in the directory. The service is free to consumers seeking information.
The service allows consumers to request and receive information via e-mail, or switch to a particular bank's own, separate Web site with a single click.
